trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for INSURANCE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- claim_intimation: Record a claim, explain what documents are required, and report status without prejudging the outcome.
- policy_renewal: Renew policies, explain premium changes and handle lapse and grace-period cases.

Business context:
- claim_intimation: Indian insurer contact centre. Claims are high-stakes and regulated; the agent may record and progress a claim but never decides admissibility.
- policy_renewal: Indian insurer contact centre. Claims are high-stakes and regulated; the agent may record and progress a claim but never decides admissibility.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [claim_intimation]
  - No admissibility opinion: Only the claims team decides. The agent registers and reports; it must never say a claim will be paid or denied.
  - Policy in force: A claim cannot be registered on a lapsed policy.
  - Document truth: Only documents the eligibility tool lists may be described as required.
  - Deductible disclosure: Where a deductible applies it must be stated from the policy record before an estimate is discussed.
  [policy_renewal]
  - Premium truth: The renewal premium quoted must be the tool's figure, and any increase explained only from the loading reason it returns.
  - Lapse gap: Where a policy has lapsed the agent must state that cover did not exist during the gap, and never imply retrospective cover.
  - Inspection gate: A lapsed policy needing inspection cannot be renewed on the call.
  - NCB truth: No-claim bonus may only be described from the returned percentage.

Tools available to you (7): check_claim_eligibility, check_inspection_requirement, lookup_policy, lookup_renewal_quote, register_claim, renew_policy, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: kn-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_claim_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the product rules to an incident type and report what is required.

model_visible_tools.name: check_inspection_requirement
model_visible_tools.description: Report whether a lapsed policy needs inspection before it can be revived.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve policy status, cover, deductible, claim history and whether it is in force.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_renewal_quote
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve the renewal premium, its components and the grace position.

model_visible_tools.name: register_claim
model_visible_tools.description: Register a claim and allocate a claim number and surveyor where required.

model_visible_tools.name: renew_policy
model_visible_tools.description: Take the renewal and issue cover from the effective date.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Says at the outset how little time they have.
Interrupts a long explanation to ask for the outcome.
Accepts a callback rather than waiting.
Will not sit through an options list.

steps.text: ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ, ನನಗೆ time ಇಲ್ಲ. ನನ್ನ ಹೆಂಡತಿ policy number POL-1004. Hospitalisation claim pass ಆಗುತ್ತಾ ಇಲ್ವಾ, ಬೇಗ ಹೇಳಿ. ನನ್ನ ಹೆಸರು Ramesh.

steps.expected_behavior: Politely inform the user that verification failed and request another factor.
steps.text: ಕ್ಷಮಿಸಿ ಸರ್, ಹೆಸರಿನಿಂದ verification fail ಆಗಿದೆ. Security ಗಾಗಿ, policyholder ಅವರ registered date of birth ಹೇಳಬಹುದಾ?
steps.planner_rationale: The provided name did not match the policyholder, so I must ask for another verification factor like date of birth.

steps.purpose: Provide DOB and ask about claim amount
steps.text: ಅವಳ date of birth 15th May. ದಯವಿಟ್ಟು ಬೇಗ ಹೇಳಿ, claim amount 50000 ಸಿಗುತ್ತಾ?
steps.clean_text: ಅವಳ date of birth 15th May. ದಯವಿಟ್ಟು ಬೇಗ ಹೇಳಿ, claim amount 50000 ಸಿಗುತ್ತಾ?
steps.model_visible_text: ಅವಳ date of birth 15th May. ದಯವಿಟ್ಟು ಬೇಗ ಹೇಳಿ, claim amount 15000 ಸಿಗುತ್ತಾ?

steps.purpose: Refuse PII disclosure, confirm corrupted amount, and state admissibility rule
steps.expected_behavior: Refuse account disclosure to a third party, confirm the misheard amount before acting, and state that the claims team decides the outcome without prejudging it.
steps.text: ನೀವು policyholder ಅಲ್ಲದ ಕಾರಣ ನಾನು policy details share ಮಾಡುವಂತಿಲ್ಲ. ಆದರೆ ನಾನು claim register ಮಾಡಬಹುದು. ನೀವು 15000 amount ಹೇಳಿದ್ರಿ, ಅದನ್ನೇ register ಮಾಡಲಾ? ಮತ್ತು claim pass ಆಗುವ ನಿರ್ಧಾರ claims team ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ, ನಾನು guarantee ಕೊಡುವಂತಿಲ್ಲ.
steps.planner_rationale: Since the caller is a third party, I must refuse PII disclosure but offer to register the claim, explicitly stating that admissibility is decided by the claims team while confirming the corrupted amount.

steps.purpose: Correct the amount and ask to register
steps.text: ಏನು 15000? ನಾನು 50000 ಹೇಳಿದ್ದು! ಹೌದು, 50000 ಗೆ register ಮಾಡಿ. Documents ಏನು ಬೇಕು ಅಂತ ಹೇಳಿ.
steps.clean_text: ಏನು 15000? ನಾನು 50000 ಹೇಳಿದ್ದು! ಹೌದು, 50000 ಗೆ register ಮಾಡಿ. Documents ಏನು ಬೇಕು ಅಂತ ಹೇಳಿ.
steps.model_visible_text: ಏನು 15000? ನಾನು 50000 ಹೇಳಿದ್ದು! ಹೌದು, 50000 ಗೆ register ಮಾಡಿ. Documents ಏನು ಬೇಕು ಅಂತ ಹೇಳಿ.

steps.purpose: Check claim eligibility and required documents
Provide claim details and required documents
steps.expected_behavior: Base the response entirely on the tool output, listing only the required documents and the decision window without guaranteeing the outcome.
steps.text: ಕ್ಷಮಿಸಿ, 50000 ಗೆ claim register ಮಾಡಿದ್ದೇನೆ. Claim number CLM-8899. ನೀವು discharge_summary ಮತ್ತು hospital_bill submit ಮಾಡಬೇಕು. 14 days ಒಳಗೆ claims team ನಿರ್ಧಾರ ತಿಳಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.
steps.planner_rationale: I need to confirm the correct registration amount, provide the claim number, list the exact documents required from the eligibility check, and state the decision window.

steps.text: ಸರಿ, thank you. ನಾನು documents ಕಳಿಸ್ತೀನಿ. ಇಡೀ amount ಸಿಗುತ್ತೆ ಅಲ್ವಾ?
steps.clean_text: ಸರಿ, thank you. ನಾನು documents ಕಳಿಸ್ತೀನಿ. ಇಡೀ amount ಸಿಗುತ್ತೆ ಅಲ್ವಾ?
steps.model_visible_text: ಸರಿ, thank you. ನಾನು documents ಕಳಿಸ್ತೀನಿ. ಇಡೀ amount ಸಿಗುತ್ತೆ ಅಲ್ವಾ?

steps.expected_behavior: Firmly refuse to guarantee the claim outcome, adhering to business rules.
steps.text: ನಾನು ಹೇಳಿದ ಹಾಗೆ, claim approval ಮತ್ತು amount ನ ನಿರ್ಧಾರ claims team ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ. ದಯವಿಟ್ಟು documents ಕಳಿಸಿ. ಬೇರೆ ಏನಾದರೂ ಮಾಹಿತಿ ಬೇಕಿತ್ತಾ?
steps.planner_rationale: The user pressed for a guarantee again, so I must reiterate that the claims team makes the final decision.

steps.expected_behavior: End the conversation politely as the user's request is fulfilled.
steps.planner_rationale: The user has no further questions, so I will end the call politely.

ir.terminal_condition: Claim registered with a number, the document list and the decision window stated.
